name: When is the best time to install bathroom floor tile during a bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to install bathroom floor tile during a bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: During a bathroom renovation, floor tile installation typically occurs after major demolition, plumbing rough-in, and electrical work are completed, but before fixtures like the vanity, toilet, and shower enclosure are permanently installed. This sequence ensures a clean, unobstructed workspace for tiling and prevents damage to new fixtures. Walls should ideally be prepped and painted (or at least primed) before floor tile, as wall work can be messy. Installing floor tile at this stage allows for proper curing of adhesives and grout before heavy items are placed on it, ensuring a durable finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Floor tile installation usually happens after demolition, plumbing, and electrical rough-in, but before permanent fixture installation. This allows for proper curing and avoids damage to new fixtures.
